summary.text: Chuck Sheedy, listed by Ballotpedia as Charles Sheedy, is a Republican member of the West Virginia House of Delegates for District 7, which he has represented since December 2022, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He served in the U.S. Army from 1976 to 2013.

paragraphs.text: Chuck Sheedy was born in Washington, Pennsylvania, and served in the United States Army from 1976 to 2013.
He attended Point Park University, Fairmont State University and Mountain State University for undergraduate study.
His career experience includes working as a construction worker, highway equipment operator, highway construction inspector and Marshall County administrator.
Ballotpedia lists him as affiliated with the Freemasons, the American Legion and the Boy Scouts of America.
Sheedy took office in the House of Delegates on December 1, 2022, succeeding Republican Trenton Barnhart, and advanced from the Republican primary on May 12, 2026.
